title: Activity Selection
statement:
You are given N activities with their start and finish times. Select the maximum number of activities that can be performed by a single person, assuming that a person can only work on a single activity at a time.
An activity `i` can be selected if you haven't selected any other activity that overlaps with it. Activity `i` overlaps with activity `j` if their time intervals intersect. (An activity finishing at time `t` and another starting at time `t` do NOT overlap).
inputFormat:
Line 1: N (number of activities).
Next N lines: two space-separated integers `start_i` and `finish_i`.
outputFormat: A single integer denoting the maximum number of activities.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
activities = [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]
